description: Meshtastic client for the M5Stack CardputerZero

store.summary: Send and receive Meshtastic messages over LoRa on the CardputerZero.
store.description: A Meshtastic client for the M5Stack CardputerZero and Cap LoRa-1262. Public/private channel messaging, delivery results and retries, saved conversations/drafts, nodes and radar map, quick messages, location controls, traceroute, channel QR import/share, profiles and diagnostics. A native LVGL UI uses an unprivileged background radio supervisor. Prerequisites: Debian 13 arm64, the qualified meshtasticd 2.7.26 build and meshtastic 2.7.11 in an app-private Python environment; see the source installation guide. Optional camera scanning also requires its documented camera/QR dependencies. Attach the antenna before enabling the radio. First setup is receive-only; transmitting and location sharing require explicit choices. Private channel keys and local history remain sensitive.
